task: hand motor imagery recordings; no classification accuracy endpoint
source_reading: mne.io.read_raw_edf(preload=True), mne.datasets.eegbci.standardize before channel selection; no artifact rejection or epoch selection

filter_spec.implementation: scipy.signal.butter(4,[1.0,30.0],btype='bandpass',fs=160,output='sos') followed by sosfiltfilt on complete recording

counterfactual: multiply the original real EEG signal within the heldout interval by -1; all source samples outside the heldout interval unchanged. This is synthetic intervention on real EEG, not a clinically plausible counterfactual truth.
negative_control: both clean and altered EEG copies have heldout source interval overwritten by exactly the same zero vector BEFORE sosfiltfilt, producing exact equality
source_data_retention: never commit original EDF or any EEG sample values; publish only identifiers, checksums and aggregate scalar transfer effects
registered_unit: Four independent participants; two runs and two channels per participant are repeated measures. Each guard condition is another repeated counterfactual, NOT an independent participant.
hard_failure_conditions: nonfinite source samples or too short recording
any unregistered guard or perturbed sample outside heldout interval
false_claims_prohibited: independent replication by a separate group
new theorem priority for IIR tail propagation
